terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using Deep Audiobooks.

using.title: Using Deep Audiobooks
using.p1: By creating an account or listening on Deep Audiobooks you agree to these terms. Please use the service lawfully and only for personal, non-commercial listening.

account.title: Your account
account.b1: Keep your password safe; you are responsible for activity on your account.
account.b2: Give us accurate details when you register.
account.b3: We may suspend accounts that misuse the service or break these terms.

content.title: Content and licence
content.p1: All audiobooks, stories, artwork and text on Deep Audiobooks belong to us or our content partners. Your plan gives you a personal, non-transferable right to listen. You may not copy, record, resell or redistribute the content.

plans.title: Plans and payments
plans.p1: Paid plans are described on the Plans page. Prices and features may change; any change will not affect a plan you have already paid for until it renews. See our Refund and Cancellation Policy for details.

availability.title: Availability
availability.p1: We work hard to keep Deep Audiobooks available but cannot promise uninterrupted service. We may update or remove features and titles from time to time.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: Questions about these terms? Reach us through the Contact Us page.

privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what Deep Audiobooks collects, why, and how it is used.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.p1: When you use Deep Audiobooks we collect only what we need to run the service:
collect.b1: Account details you give us: name, email address, mobile number and password.
collect.b2: Listening activity: the stories you play, how far you listened, your favourites and ratings.
collect.b3: Basic device and usage information that helps us keep the app and website working.

use.title: How we use your information
use.b1: To create your account and let you sign in.
use.b2: To remember your recently listened stories and favourites so you can resume anywhere.
use.b3: To improve recommendations, fix problems and keep the service secure.
use.b4: To send service messages and, if you subscribe, our newsletter.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.p1: We do not sell your personal information. We only share it with service providers who help us run Deep Audiobooks (for example hosting and payment providers), or when the law requires it.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.p1: You can ask us to correct or delete your account information, and you can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time. Write to us from the Contact Us page and we will help.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: If we change this policy we will update this page and the date above.

help.intro: Find quick answers about listening, downloads, renting and your account.

findBooks.q: How do I find a book?
findBooks.a: Use the Search tab to look for a story, author, narrator or genre. You can also browse the sections and genres on the Home screen.

freeEpisode.q: Can I listen before I rent?
freeEpisode.a: Many books have a free episode. Open the book and tap "Play free episode". The remaining episodes unlock when you rent the book or have Premium.

changeLanguage.q: How do I change the app language?
changeLanguage.a: Tap the language button at the top of this page, or choose a language from the language screen. The whole app, including this Help Center, switches at once.

resume.q: How do I continue where I stopped?
resume.a: Tap Resume on the Home screen, or open Library and tap Last played. The player opens at the episode and the second where you stopped.

speedTimer.q: How do I change the speed or set a sleep timer?
speedTimer.a: Open the player. Tap the speed button to change how fast the story plays, and the moon button to set a sleep timer.

audioVideo.q: How do I switch between audio and video?
audioVideo.a: If an episode has a video, a switch button appears in the player. Tap it to move between audio and video.

background.q: Does the audio play when the screen is locked?
background.a: Yes. Audio keeps playing in the background and you can pause or resume it from the lock screen.

download.q: How do I download an episode?
download.a: Open the book and tap the download icon next to the episode. Video can be downloaded only for episodes that have a video.

downloadsWhere.a: Open the Library tab. Downloaded audio and downloaded video are listed separately, and they play without internet.

rentVsPremium.q: What is the difference between renting and Premium?
rentVsPremium.a: Renting unlocks one book for a limited time. Premium unlocks the Premium library for as long as your plan is active.

rentalExpiry.q: How do I know when my rental ends?
rentalExpiry.a: Open the Library tab. Under Rented books, each book shows how many days are left.

cart.q: How do I rent more than one book at once?
cart.a: Tap Add to Cart on each book, then open the cart and check out once.

devices.q: Can I use my account on another phone?
devices.a: Yes, you can sign in on another device. A limited number of devices can be signed in at the same time.

logout.q: What happens when I log out?
logout.a: Playback stops and you are signed out. Your downloads on this phone stay until you remove them.
